summary.text: Andrea Biscardi is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Scotty Stokes for an open seat.

A registered nurse and case manager, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities include lowering prescription drug costs and expanding access to health care in rural and underserved communities.

paragraphs.text: Andrea Biscardi graduated from Manchester High School West, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Tulsa in 2005 and an associate degree from the Breckenridge School of Nursing in 2012.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born in Tulsa, spent most of her childhood in Manchester, New Hampshire, and returned to Oklahoma to attend the University of Tulsa, where she earned a bachelor's degree in Psychology.

She said she has served Green Country residents for more than 20 years, 13 of them as a registered nurse, and has worked at the Office of the Chief Medical Examiner, Ascension St. John Medical Center and Tulsa Nursing Center, and currently on an Assertive Community Treatment team at Family and Children's Services.

In the survey, Biscardi said she would fight to lower prescription drug costs, reduce insurance premiums and expand access to quality health care in rural and underserved communities, and that Oklahoma should invest in preventative care and mental health services.
